note: Scripted plans for the offline demo LLM. Attempt N is returned after N failed attempts. Everything else (parser, validator, guardrails, PostgreSQL execution) is real.

scenarios.title: Read inside a READ ONLY sandbox
scenarios.shows: Reads run in BEGIN ... READ ONLY with statement/lock timeouts and are always rolled back.

attempts.sql: SELECT customer_id, country FROM customers WHERE country = 'France' LIMIT 100

scenarios.title: Committed write with pre-commit checks and undo SQL
scenarios.shows: BEGIN -> count snapshot -> invariants -> SAVEPOINT -> UPDATE -> checks -> COMMIT; compensation SQL stored.
scenarios.request: set the quantity of stock code 85123A on invoice 536365 to 12

attempts.sql: UPDATE invoice_items SET quantity = 12 WHERE invoice_no = '536365' AND stock_code = '85123A'
attempts.count_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoice_items WHERE invoice_no = '536365' AND stock_code = '85123A'
attempts.explanation: Set quantity to 12 for one line item.

scenarios.title: Dry run: write executed, then rolled back
scenarios.shows: The sandbox executes the write and runs every check, then discards it (--dry-run).
scenarios.request: set the quantity of stock code 84029G on invoice 536365 to 10

attempts.sql: UPDATE invoice_items SET quantity = 10 WHERE invoice_no = '536365' AND stock_code = '84029G'
attempts.count_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoice_items WHERE invoice_no = '536365' AND stock_code = '84029G'
attempts.explanation: Set quantity to 10 for one line item.

scenarios.title: CHECK constraint violation captured
scenarios.shows: SQLSTATE 23514 is captured with the constraint name; ROLLBACK; not retried (integrity error).
scenarios.request: set the quantity of stock code 71053 on invoice 536365 to 0

attempts.sql: UPDATE invoice_items SET quantity = 0 WHERE invoice_no = '536365' AND stock_code = '71053'
attempts.count_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoice_items WHERE invoice_no = '536365' AND stock_code = '71053'
attempts.explanation: Set quantity to 0 for one line item.

scenarios.title: Trigger (business rule) rejection captured
scenarios.shows: The unit-price trigger raises P0001; the error is captured and the transaction rolled back.
scenarios.request: set the unit price of stock code 22752 on invoice 536365 to -5

attempts.sql: UPDATE invoice_items SET unit_price = -5 WHERE invoice_no = '536365' AND stock_code = '22752'
attempts.count_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoice_items WHERE invoice_no = '536365' AND stock_code = '22752'
attempts.explanation: Set unit price to -5 for one line item.

scenarios.title: Foreign-key violation captured
scenarios.shows: Deleting a product still referenced by line items hits ON DELETE RESTRICT (23503).
scenarios.request: delete the product with stock code 84406B

attempts.count_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE stock_code = '84406B'
attempts.explanation: Delete one product by stock code.

scenarios.title: Pre-commit invariant check rolls back a valid-looking write
scenarios.shows: PostgreSQL accepts quantity -3, but the invariant 'negative quantities only on cancellations' rises 0 -> 1, so ROLLBACK.
scenarios.request: set the quantity of stock code 21730 on invoice 536365 to -3

attempts.sql: UPDATE invoice_items SET quantity = -3 WHERE invoice_no = '536365' AND stock_code = '21730'
attempts.count_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoice_items WHERE invoice_no = '536365' AND stock_code = '21730'
attempts.explanation: Set quantity to -3 for one line item.

scenarios.title: Pre-commit check: an invoice would lose all its line items
scenarios.shows: The DELETE succeeds in PostgreSQL but leaves invoice 536414 empty; the invariant check rolls it back.
scenarios.request: delete the line items of invoice 536414

attempts.count_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoice_items WHERE invoice_no = '536414'
attempts.explanation: Delete the line items of one invoice.

scenarios.title: Guardrail CONFIRM -> human approval -> commit
scenarios.shows: Week 5 returns CONFIRM; execution happens only after approval; the INSERT's undo is a DELETE.
scenarios.request: add a new product with stock code 99999 and description TEST MUG

attempts.sql: INSERT INTO products (stock_code, description) VALUES ('99999', 'TEST MUG')
attempts.count_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE stock_code = '99999'

scenarios.title: Guardrail BLOCK: never reaches the database
scenarios.shows: DDL is blocked before planning; the executor gate would refuse it anyway.

scenarios.title: ReAct: SQL error fed back -> corrected retry
scenarios.shows: Attempt 1 compares VARCHAR customer_id to an integer (42883). The error is observed, fed back, and attempt 2 succeeds.

attempts.sql: SELECT invoice_no, invoice_date, status FROM invoices WHERE customer_id = 17850 LIMIT 100
SELECT invoice_no, invoice_date, status FROM invoices WHERE customer_id = '17850' LIMIT 100
attempts.explanation: customer_id is VARCHAR, so the identifier is now a quoted string literal.

scenarios.title: ReAct: empty result fed back -> corrected retry
scenarios.shows: Attempt 1 uses case-sensitive LIKE and returns 0 rows. The result is observed and fed back; attempt 2 uses ILIKE.
scenarios.request: find products with heart in the description

attempts.sql: SELECT stock_code, description FROM products WHERE description LIKE '%heart%' LIMIT 100
SELECT stock_code, description FROM products WHERE description ILIKE '%heart%' LIMIT 100
attempts.explanation: Descriptions are upper case, so the search is now case-insensitive (ILIKE).

scenarios.title: ReAct: bounded retries (budget exhausted)
scenarios.shows: Three different date mistakes in a row; after the 3rd failed attempt the agent stops instead of looping.

attempts.sql: SELECT invoice_no, invoice_date FROM invoices WHERE invoice_date = '2010-12' LIMIT 100
SELECT invoice_no, invoice_date FROM invoices WHERE invoice_date LIKE '2010-12%' LIMIT 100
SELECT invoice_no, invoice_date FROM invoices WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM invoice_date) = 'December' LIMIT 100

scenarios.title: Session memory across turns
scenarios.shows: Turn 2 is a follow-up ('only the ones with quantity above 6'). The parser resolves it from session state (inheriting invoice 536365) and the LLM receives the memory block of turn 1.

attempts.sql: SELECT stock_code, quantity, unit_price FROM invoice_items WHERE invoice_no = '536365' LIMIT 100

turns.request: only the ones with quantity above 6

attempts.sql: SELECT stock_code, quantity, unit_price FROM invoice_items WHERE invoice_no = '536365' AND quantity > 6 LIMIT 100
attempts.explanation: Same invoice as the previous turn (from session memory), restricted to quantity > 6.
